description: A held server is started with the rest (runtime.zig `.need` without its held check)
old: Started(x) == IF x = "idle" THEN "starting" ELSE x
new: Started(x) == IF x \in {"idle", "waiting"} THEN "starting" ELSE x

description: A reload makes the new host but never starts its servers (reloadHost without startHostServers)
The status line keeps reading the first host after a reload
Quitting signals only the current host's running servers
A removed server is loaded as an idle one
Only the first host's owner starts processes, so servers after a reload never settle
A server whose host let go of it never exits until fx quits
old:
/\ <<h, s>> \in stopping
    /\ stopping' = stopping \ {<<h, s>>}
    /\ refreshed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, cur, alive, retired, leases, st, procs, termed
new:
/\ <<h, s>> \in stopping /\ quit
    /\ stopping' = stopping \ {<<h, s>>}
    /\ refreshed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<decision, cur, alive, retired, leases, st, procs, termed

description: A new host starts a server while a leased old host still runs it
